US Federal Reserve likely to hold interest rates steady in October

The US Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October, with a top official signaling the central bank's intention. This potential pause comes as the US labor market shows signs of cooling more than anticipated, suggesting a potential skip on an October rate hike.
